- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Temporality): 跟妈妈搬家：跟妈妈搬了家，This is a completed move at a specific age, so the completed action needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
Run 2: 跟妈妈搬家：孟母带着他搬家，The subject who moves together with someone uses 跟; when the mother takes her child to move, use 带着. [vocab list]
Run 3: 跟妈妈：孟母带着他，The original wording presents Mengzi as simply accompanying his mother. To describe the mother moving Mengzi, make the mother the subject and use 带着. [vocab list]
